tuning: no test tuning; every deviation is a declared source-based adaptation

adaptations.pdm_parameterization: ve (paper state y). 2026-11-14: the VP-state variant was removed because it projected the sqrt(alphabar_t)-scaled state onto the *unscaled* set C, and did not carry y across levels; that is neither the paper VE algorithm nor an exact reparameterisation (docs/DSH_FIX_REPORT_20261114.md §4d).
adaptations.pdm_step_convention: official_ald: paper Algorithm 1 line 3 (gamma_t = sigma_t^2/2 sigma_T^2) is unusable with this frozen 16-level schedule because sigma_T^2/sigma_min^2 = 8.8e6, so the per-step mixing rate is 1/(2 sigma_T^2) = 4.7e-6 and M=100 steps cannot move the sample; the paper reference implementation (projected_diffusion/scoremodel.py) uses step_size = eps*(sigma/sigma_min)^2. Both are implemented in algorithms/pdm/runner.py:level_gamma and the choice is recorded per run. eps=2e-3 gives mixing ratio eps/sigma_min^2 = 0.166 per step.
adaptations.pdm_inner: 20 instead of M=100 (PDM App.F explicitly permits reducing M for expensive CPU projections).
adaptations.segment_constraints_for: diagnostic variant: all seven use per-vertex free-space rows, so it is NOT a paper-native PDM run (see Problem B in docs/DSH_FIX_REPORT_20261114.md §4e).
adaptations.cd_levels_and_extra: 64 level visits (each trained level repeated ~4x, which is a discretisation refinement of the same per-level Langevin target) plus the paper's 64 extra updates at the lowest trained level.
adaptations.dual_eta_rho: paper Appendix C 'large' setting eta_lambda=1e-3, rho=2.5e-4 divided by dual_constraint_scale (128) so that the value entering the scaled constraint rows reproduces the paper's physical step.
adaptations.rho_growth: paper only requires c>1; 1.01 is carried over from the previous adaptation and is not from the source
adaptations.cbf: SafeDiffuser continuous-time CBF integrated with dt=1 per level, 16 sub-steps and a per-point step cap; the refinement study is in docs/native_point_integration_convergence.json
adaptations.timeouts: 180 s per method (300 s for the 4-particle Primal-Dual/ALM, 900 s for PDM with segment projections). 2026-11-14: Primal-Dual/ALM previously had no entry and silently inherited the 10 s default, which they now exceed at 256 levels.
adaptations.pdm_ald_eps: derived: official ALD delta_t = eps*(sigma/sigma_min)^2 with the paper form gamma=delta/2 gives gamma/sigma^2 = eps/(2 sigma_min^2); eps fixed so that ratio = 1/6. Fixes the earlier factor-of-2 (gamma=delta_t) error.
adaptations.dual_eta: paper Appendix C "large" eta_lambda=1e-3, divided by dual_constraint_scale^2=16384 because g was scaled by 128 (equivalence: lambda'=lambda/s, eta'=eta/s^2; test_dual_units_invariance).
adaptations.rho: paper Appendix C "large" rho=2.5e-4 divided by dual_constraint_scale^2=16384 (rho'=rho/s^2).
adaptations.cd_levels: every trained level is visited: eq.(6) uses that level's own beta_t, which is only correct when the ladder is not subsampled.

validation_selection: Frozen20 equally spaced validation indices; no outcome selection, no parameter tuning on this run.
_role: template read by scripts/make_aligned_configs.py; the generated configs are the ones to run
